notes:
Summary: Mid-market product analytics SaaS evaluating Redwood for embeddings + semantic search. Started self-serve with Hosted API (quick POC for relevance), now moving to Dedicated evaluation for predictable RPU and cost. Primary drivers: improve search relevance for product docs, scale nightly batch embedding jobs, lower per-embedding unit cost.

Stakeholders: VP Eng (Rina Kapoor), Head of Data (Carlos Mendes), CTO (internal), Product lead (Sasha Li). AE: Maya Chen; SE: Liam O'Neill. Security contact: security@helionforge.com.

Requirements/high level: 
- Workload: ~50M existing docs, nightly batch re-embed of 1.5M changed objects; real-time query load ~200-300 qps at 99th p90 latency target <120ms for vector nearest-neighbor lookup (end-to-end).
- Throughput: need throughput tests for batch embed throughput (>=5k embeds/min) and real-time vector lookup latency at scale.
- Integration: plan to use Milvus (on our infra) for vector store; want guidance on embedding payload size, sharding, and efficient upload patterns.
- Model preferences: leaning open models (gpt-like open weights) for cost control; also interested in Redwood-verified smaller embed models. Quantization + int8 considerations for Dedicated.
- Routing/fallback: want strategy for overflow to Hosted during Dedicated maintenance windows; sticky routing by region.
- Security/compliance: SOC2 required, SSO/SAML integration, audit logs for token usage, optional KMS integration for key management, data residency (US + EU restrictions for some customers).
- Cost sensitivity: tight budget for mid-market; forecasted ARR $50-150k, want predictable committed pricing for Dedicated.

Timeline & recent activity: 
- 2025-11-02: Lead created (trial sign-up, small hosted run).
- 2025-11-10: Hosted API quickstart, ran embedding smoke tests against 5k docs. Notes in gmail_thread_Abc1234.
- 2025-12-05: Intro demo with Maya + SE overview. Fireflies ff_20251205_intro.
- 2026-01-18: Security questionnaire submitted, drive doc updated (helionforge_security_questions.docx).
- 2026-01-27: Hosted API performance run: observed encoder latency ~45ms per embed (small batch), queries ~70ms at low load. Shared results with Carlos.
- 2026-02-03: Deep-dive POC demo (embeddings + search) with SE. Fireflies ff_20260203_helionforge_demo. SE outlined Dedicated sizing options and batching/caching recommendations.
- 2026-02-10: Customer provided vector DB architecture (Milvus cluster specs), asked for ingestion pattern best practices and target RPS guidance.
- 2026-02-14: Redwood provided preliminary Dedicated sizing and ballpark committed pricing; customer requested an explicit throughput test plan and a pricing scenario showing commit vs burst tradeoffs.

POC scope (agreed): 
- Week 1: Run Hosted API baseline embedding and semantic search tests at 10k doc scale (complete).
- Week 2: Batch ingestion pattern test (5k embeds/min target) with parallelized workers; measure network + tokenization bottlenecks.
- Week 3: Dedicated sizing smoke: spin dedicated pool (8 GPU nodes) in staging region, run 100k embed job and 200 qps query traffic for 30 minutes, capture p50/p95/p99 latencies.
- Week 4: Security validation and contract review (legal + renewals).

Open questions / blockers: 
- Legal: need DPA + standard MID-MARKET terms; procurement timeline unclear.
- Milvus integration: customer asks for sample connector patterns (SE to deliver sample code).
- Pricing: customer requests a committed vs consumption comparison for their 12-month forecast (showing when Dedicated pays off).

Next steps: 
- SE Liam to deliver dedicated sizing test plan and sample Milvus ingestion scripts by 2026-02-18.
- Maya to follow up with procurement with draft MSA and DPA by 2026-02-21.
- Schedule dedicated smoke test window with Helion infra team during week of 2026-02-24.

Notes style: shorthand, chatty, flagged items in ALL CAPS occasionally in call notes. Example quote from VP Eng: "Need predictable unit economics — we cannot have token bills swing 4x month-to-month."
